identity.title: Data freshness
identity.summary: Each source's latest date, the date expected, and whether it is current.

request.description: Which sources; every source when null.

sources.description: Source names, as this capability returns them: harbour.holdings. At most 1000 in one call (invalid_request beyond); every source when null.

result.description: One row per source, by name.

source.description: The source: what landed, such as harbour.holdings.

latest_date.description: The latest business date that has landed; null before the first.

expected_date.description: The business date that should have landed by the register's last check: Harbour's sources land once a business day (Monday to Friday, with no holiday calendar), by 06:00 UTC the next day.

status.description: Whether the source is current, as this call finds it: current when its latest date is on or after its expected date, late when it is before, and unchecked when the register has not checked it within 26 hours.

x-atlas-enum.description: The expected date has not landed.
The register has not checked the source within 26 hours, so whether its expected date has landed is not known.
A value this reader does not know (§9.5.5).

checked_at.description: When the load register last checked the source. It checks every source once a day, at 06:00 UTC; a check more than 26 hours old leaves the status unchecked.

errors.description: The warehouse that serves Harbour's views is suspended or unreachable.
errors.next: Wait retry_after seconds, then repeat the call.

meaning.current: a source is current when its latest date is on or after its expected date
meaning.history: the latest state of each source, not a history of every landing

usage.when: You need to know how fresh a source is before trusting its latest answer: for portfolio.holdings@v1, the source harbour.holdings. Freshness is per source: a portfolio's own latest valuation can lag its source, so read the as_of of each row you get.
usage.when_not: You need a source's history of landings: no capability offers it yet.

changelog.change: Added the status unchecked: the status is now judged when a call asks, from the dates and how recently the register checked them. Stated the calendar, the register's checks and the most sources one call may name.
